## Definition of Done (docs/agent-team.md §4)
- [ ] Failing test written first and committed (TDD)
- [ ] Tests pass; coverage gate met; lint and types clean
- [ ] Docstrings and docs updated; traceability matrix updated
- [ ] No silently ignored config keys; no hard-coded data paths
- [ ] Migrations reversible (if any)
- [ ] Decision logged in `docs/decision-log.md` or ADR added (if consequential)
- [ ] Reviewed by a second role (Security if auth/upload/public; Validation if numbers change)

## Needs owner approval?
- [ ] Methodology change  - [ ] Spends money  - [ ] Deletes data/anything consequential  - [ ] Publishes publicly
